# AI Free API

> > Comprehensive guides for accessing and optimizing AI APIs including Gemini, Claude, GPT, Sora, and image generation models with pricing comparisons and China access solutions.

AI Free API provides detailed technical documentation, cost optimization strategies, and practical integration guides for major AI models from Google, OpenAI, and Anthropic. The site specializes in API rate limits, pricing analysis, and solutions for accessing AI services from China.
